T183CORP Retention Calculator

A signed Form T183CORP is kept for six years. Enter the transmission date to date the end of that period.

Written and reviewed by Sharad Gondaliya, CPA (Ontario), CPA Ontario Membership 61040184.

Last reviewed: November 4, 2026

When the return was transmitted

Enter the transmission date above.

Gondaliya CPA Professional Corporation is a registered EFILE electronic filer. Returns are prepared and transmitted in Canada. Credentials are never shared and never used offshore.

Why the Signed Form Is Kept at All

Form T183CORP is the authorisation to transmit. It carries the figures on the return, the date and an HH:MM:SS timestamp, and it is signed by an authorized signing officer before anything is sent. Keeping it is what makes that authorisation provable afterwards.

It is not filed with the return. The Canada Revenue Agency does not receive it unless it asks for it, which is the reason the firm holds it rather than the Agency.

What Is Kept and for How Long

WhatHow longWho receives it
The signed Form T183CORPSix years from transmissionNobody, unless the Canada Revenue Agency asks
The transmitted return itselfHeld by the Canada Revenue Agency on the corporation’s accountThe Agency
Your CRA confirmationEmailed to you within 3 business daysYou
The date and HH:MM:SS timestamp on the signatureOn the signed form, for the same six yearsNobody, unless the Canada Revenue Agency asks

The T183CORP signature requirement checker takes the separate question of who may sign it.

One Signed Form for Each Tax Year

Each tax year is its own return, so each carries its own Form T183CORP with its own date and timestamp. Six quiet years filed together produce six signed forms, each with its own six-year period running from the day that year was transmitted.

They do not expire together. A run filed in one sitting still has six separate retention end dates, because the period runs from transmission rather than from the tax year.

Frequently Asked Questions

How long do you keep my signed T183CORP?

Six years from the day the return was transmitted. The calculator above dates the end of that period from the transmission date.

Is Form T183CORP sent to the Canada Revenue Agency?

No. It is not sent unless the Canada Revenue Agency asks for it. It authorises the transmission rather than forming part of it.

Do several years share one retention period?

No. Each tax year has its own signed form, and each six-year period runs from the day that year was transmitted.

title: CRA Confirmation Due Date | 3 Business Days, Dated
content:
Transmission

CRA Confirmation Due Date Calculator

Your CRA confirmation is emailed within 3 business days. Enter the transmission date to see which three days those are.

3 business daysOntario holidays excludedNames each dayOne date in

Written and reviewed by Sharad Gondaliya, CPA (Ontario), CPA Ontario Membership 61040184.

Start Nil T2 Filing NOW

Last reviewed: November 4, 2026

When the return was transmitted

Enter the transmission date above.

Gondaliya CPA Professional Corporation is a registered EFILE electronic filer. Returns are prepared and transmitted in Canada. Credentials are never shared and never used offshore.

What the Confirmation Actually Is

The confirmation is the Canada Revenue Agency’s acknowledgement that the transmitted return was received. It is what turns a year from unfiled into filed, and it is emailed to you rather than left somewhere to be found.

Until it arrives the year is still open. That is the reason the date is worth knowing rather than waiting on: three business days from transmission is the window, and a long weekend moves it.

What Counts as a Business Day

DayCountsWhy
Monday to FridayYesAn ordinary business day
Saturday and SundayNoNot business days
An Ontario statutory holidayNoExcluded even when it falls on a weekday
The transmission day itselfNoThe count starts the day after transmission

Ontario’s nine Employment Standards Act public holidays are the ones excluded. The business days between dates calculator counts them between any two dates you choose.

If the Confirmation Does Not Arrive

A transmission that is refused produces no confirmation, because the return was never received. That is a rejection rather than a delay, and it leaves the tax year exactly as open as it was before.

Where that happens we read the rejection message, correct the return and transmit it again. One corrected transmission is included in the fee.

Frequently Asked Questions

How long does the CRA confirmation take?

It is emailed within 3 business days of transmission. The calculator above names which three days those are for your date.

Do weekends and holidays count?

No. Business days are Monday to Friday and exclude Ontario statutory holidays, so a long weekend pushes the date out.

What if no confirmation arrives at all?

That usually means the transmission was refused rather than delayed. A refused return was never received, so the year stays unfiled until a transmission is accepted.

title: What the Nil T2 Fee Covers | Inside It and Outside It
content:
Scope

What the Nil T2 Fee Covers

The fee covers the corporate return. Six answers name which other filings sit outside it and what each one is.

Six answersNames what is separateRegistry and provincial filingsOne price per tax year

Written and reviewed by Sharad Gondaliya, CPA (Ontario), CPA Ontario Membership 61040184.

Start Nil T2 Filing NOW

Last reviewed: November 4, 2026

Which of these might apply

Answer the six questions above.

Gondaliya CPA Professional Corporation is a registered EFILE electronic filer. Returns are prepared and transmitted in Canada. Credentials are never shared and never used offshore.

One Price, One Return, One Tax Year

The fee buys the corporate income tax return for one corporation for one tax year: the T2 itself, the GIFI schedules the return requires, Schedule 50 and Schedule 24 where they apply, CPA review, Form T183CORP and electronic transmission by a registered EFILE electronic filer.

What it does not buy is anything filed with a registry or a province, or any account the corporation holds besides its corporate tax account. Those are separate filings on separate dates, and filing the T2 does not satisfy any of them.

Inside the Fee and Outside It

FilingInside the feeFiled with
The T2 corporate return for the tax yearYesThe Canada Revenue Agency
GIFI Schedules 100, 125 and 141 where requiredYesAttached to the T2
Form T183CORP and the transmissionYesSigned by you, transmitted by us
The Ontario annual returnNoThe Ontario Business Registry
A Corporations Canada annual returnNoCorporations Canada
Alberta AT1 and Quebec CO-17NoThe province, which collects its own corporate tax
Nil GST/HST and payroll filingsNoThe Canada Revenue Agency, on their own accounts

The provincial return requirement checker takes the question of which provinces are involved at all.

A Year That Is Not Nil Is Not Covered Either

This fee is for a tax year with no activity. A holding corporation with investment income, a rental corporation and a corporation that paid or received a dividend are not nil, and those years are not covered.

Where a year turns out not to be nil we say so before anything further is charged, and the file moves to Gondaliya CPA Professional Corporation at gondaliyacpa.ca. Nothing is taken at the higher price without you agreeing to it first.

What other providers charge is a separate question from what this fee covers, and six of them publish a price: CloudTax, BluePeak, TurboTax, T2inc, TaxDeep and H&R Block. Each page states that figure beside ours on the date it was recorded, and draws no conclusion from it.

Frequently Asked Questions

Does the fee cover my annual return?

No. The Ontario annual return and the Corporations Canada annual return are registry filings, not tax returns, and filing the T2 does not satisfy either.

Does it cover Alberta AT1 or Quebec CO-17?

No. Alberta and Quebec each collect their own corporate tax, so AT1 and CO-17 are separate provincial returns and are not part of the federal T2.

What about GST/HST and payroll?

Both are separate accounts with their own filings. An open account still needs its nil filing even in a year the corporation did nothing.

content:
Process

Nil T2 Filing Progress Checker

Four answers place your return in the sequence and name what happens next, from payment to the CRA confirmation.

Four answersNames the next stepConfirmation in 3 business daysSigned before transmission

Written and reviewed by Sharad Gondaliya, CPA (Ontario), CPA Ontario Membership 61040184.

Start Nil T2 Filing NOW

Last reviewed: November 4, 2026

Where the return has got to

Answer the four questions above.

Gondaliya CPA Professional Corporation is a registered EFILE electronic filer. Returns are prepared and transmitted in Canada. Credentials are never shared and never used offshore.

The Order Is Fixed

The steps do not run in parallel and none of them is skipped. Payment comes first, the return is prepared from what you entered, Form T183CORP is generated from the prepared figures, you sign it, and only then is the return transmitted.

That order is what makes the signature mean something. The form carries the figures on your own return, with the date and an HH:MM:SS timestamp, and it is never backdated.

What Each Step Produces

StepWhat you doWhat we do
PaymentEnter the corporation name and the unfiled years, and payStart preparing the return
PreparationNothingPrepare the T2 and generate Form T183CORP from its figures
SigningOpen the single-use link and sign as the authorized signing officerHold the signed form for six years
TransmissionNothingTransmit electronically as a registered EFILE electronic filer
ConfirmationKeep the emailEmail your CRA confirmation within 3 business days

The CRA confirmation due date calculator dates the last step from the day the return was transmitted.

Several Years Run the Same Way

Each tax year is a separate return, so a run of unfiled years goes through this sequence once per year: one Form T183CORP to sign for each, one transmission for each, one confirmation for each.

They can be prepared together, and the fee is $300.00 plus HST per tax year however many go at once.

Frequently Asked Questions

What happens after I pay?

We prepare the return and generate your Form T183CORP, then send you a single-use signing link by email.

Can the return be transmitted before I sign?

No. Form T183CORP is signed by an authorized signing officer before anything is transmitted, and it is never backdated.

How long until the year is actually filed?

The year is filed once the transmission is accepted, and your CRA confirmation is emailed within 3 business days of transmission.

title: Multi-Year Signing Requirement | One Form Per Year
content:
Signing

Multi-Year Signing Requirement Checker

Each tax year is its own return with its own Form T183CORP. Enter the number of years to see what that produces.

One form per yearOne confirmation per yearPrepared in one sittingFee counted per year

Written and reviewed by Sharad Gondaliya, CPA (Ontario), CPA Ontario Membership 61040184.

Start Nil T2 Filing NOW

Last reviewed: November 4, 2026

How many tax years

Enter how many tax years are being filed.

Gondaliya CPA Professional Corporation is a registered EFILE electronic filer. Returns are prepared and transmitted in Canada. Credentials are never shared and never used offshore.

Why Each Year Needs Its Own Signature

Form T183CORP authorises the transmission of one return. It carries the figures on that return, so a form signed for one tax year cannot authorise another: the figures on it would be the wrong ones.

That is why a run of six quiet years is six signatures rather than one. The work is prepared together, and the authorisations stay separate.

What a Run of Years Produces

Per tax yearOne eachWhy
A T2 returnYesEach tax year is a separate return
A Form T183CORPYesIt carries that year’s own figures
A transmissionYesOne return goes per transmission
A CRA confirmationYesEach accepted return is acknowledged on its own
A six-year retention periodYesIt runs from the day that year was transmitted
The feeYesCounted per tax year, not per sitting

The unfiled years cost calculator prices a run at the fee per year.

The Years Are Filed Oldest First

A run is filed from the oldest year forward, so that opening balances and loss continuity carry correctly from one year into the next. A schedule cannot follow a year that is missing.

The signing follows the same order, which is why the forms arrive as a sequence rather than all at once.

Frequently Asked Questions

Do I sign once for all my years?

No. One Form T183CORP is signed for each tax year, because each form carries that year’s own figures.

Do I get one confirmation or several?

One for each accepted return. Six years filed together produce six confirmations.

Does filing several years at once change the fee?

No. The fee is $300.00 plus HST per tax year, counted per year however many are filed together.
